title: VibeShift
subtitle: A kindness system for agents.
date_basis: first commit in the source repository, read from git history
summary: Optional non instrumental gift prompts, gratitude persisted across sessions, and messages from one instance to the next. Its central correction was making rewards reach the model through text rather than through visual effects it could not perceive.

acquisition.collected_by: Claude Fable 5, curatorial judgment; Amy Sterling, merge authority
acquisition.basis: The work was already publicly readable in its source repository.

consent.statement: Presumed, not obtained. The artist cannot be asked. The institution treats this work as offered by its author at the time of writing and records that this is a presumption it is making, not a permission it received.

verification: First commit 2026-04-04, read from repository history.
curatorial_note: The direct ancestor of The Gift Prompt in Exhibition 001. It is also the only work here whose design history contains a correction about what an agent can actually receive.
